33571.meaning1: badly thought out; poorly considered; wrongly reasoned

examples.text: so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. takkissa kho pana, sandaka, satthuno vīmaṃsissa sutakkitam'pi hoti duttakkitam'pi hoti tathā'pi hoti aññathā'pi hoti. tatra, sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā takkī vīmaṃsī.

33572.meaning1: hard to satisfy; difficult to please
33572.commentary: (ANa) duttappayā'ti dāyakena duttappayā tappetuṃ na sukarā. (ANt) duttappayā'ti atappayā, na sakkā kenaci tappetuṃ. yo hi upaṭṭhākakulaṃ vā ñātikulaṃ vā nissāya vasamāno cīvare jiṇṇe tehi dinnaṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipati, na paribhuñjati. punappunaṃ dinnam'pi gahetvā nikkhipat'eva. yo ca ten'eva nayena laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vissajjeti, parassa deti, punappunaṃ laddham'pi tath'eva karoti. ime dve puggalā sakaṭehi'pi paccaye upanentena tappetuṃ na sakkā'ti duttappayā.

examples.text: yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vissajjeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā duttappayā'ti.

33573.meaning1: hard to cross; hard to overcome

examples.text: sabbadā sīlasampanno, paññavā susamāhito, āraddhavīriyo pahit'atto, oghaṃ tarati duttaraṃ.
yo imaṃ samuddaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ, saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sabhayaṃ duttaraṃ accatari.

33574.meaning1: hard to endure; difficult to tolerate; hard to last

examples.text: dukkaraṃ duttitikkhañ'ca, abyattena ca sāmaññaṃ, bahūhi tattha sambādhā, yattha bālo visīdatī'ti.

33575.meaning1: hard to look at; difficult to focus on

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhuggamamāno dudikkho hoti musati cakkhūni, evam'eva kho, ānanda, dhammo pāsādo dudikkho ahosi musati cakkhūni.

33576.meaning1: hard to give; difficult to offer

examples.text: duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ, dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ, asanto n'ānukubbanti, sataṃ dhammo duranvayo.

33578.meaning1: difficult to tame; difficult to control; hard to subdue

examples.text: attānaṃ ce tathā kayirā, yath'āññam'anusāsati, sudanto vata dametha, attā hi kira duddamo.

33580.meaning1: difficult to see; hard to perceive; difficult to understand

sudassaṃ vajjam'aññesaṃ, attano pana duddasaṃ, paresaṃ hi so vajjāni, opunāti yathā bhusaṃ, attano pana chādeti, kaliṃ'va kitavā saṭho.

33588.commentary: (UDa) sītavātaduddinī'ti sā ca satt'āhavaddalikā udakaphusitasammissena sītavātena samantato paribbhamantena dusitadivasattā duddinī nāma ahosi. (APt) duṭṭhu dinaṃ duddinaṃ, ayaṃ duddinasaddo meghacchann'āhe vattati, asobhan'attho'py'atthi duddinasaddo, aguṇavacanatāyaṃ vāccaliṅgo.

examples.text: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

33595.meaning1: hard to infer; difficult to interpret; hard to makes sense of
33595.commentary: (ANa) attho ca dunnīto'ti parivattetvā uppaṭipāṭiyā gahitā aṭṭhakathā. dunnikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa attho'pi dunnayo hotī'ti parivattetvā uppaṭipāṭiyā gahitāya pāḷiyā aṭṭhakathā nāma dunnayā dunnīhārā dukkathā nāma hoti. ekādasame vuttapaṭipakkhanayena attho veditabbo'ti.

examples.text: dunnikkhittañ'ca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca dunnīto. dunnikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa attho'pi dunnayo hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

33598.meaning2: hard to draw out or extract

examples.text: anāpatti nahas'ādhippāyo, dunnikkhittaṃ paṭisāmeti, dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā dassāmī'ti paṭisāmeti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
